metadata.coordinateConversion: x = (pdfX - 354) * 40/72; y = (681 - pdfY) * 40/72; rounded to two decimals.
metadata.loading: Initialize all nodes; expand each serialized edge both ways. Runtime distance is Euclidean distance between saved positions.
metadata.weightAssumptions: All weights are 1; distances omit stair rise, effort, elevator waiting time and courtyard slope.
metadata.accessibility: Only the two explicitly AO/wheelchair-marked end entrance edges are true. Lecture stair traversal is false. Other edges are unknown; no complete accessible route is established.

nodes.nodeConvention: Room nodes are visible doorways. Additional nodes retain circulation bends, junctions and transfer approaches.
nodes.distanceConvention: Euclidean feet from rounded endpoint positions; weight 1. No vertical-distance override. Aligned transfers may have zero distance; stair effort and elevator waiting are omitted.
nodes.accessibility: Omitted means unknown. Only source-marked AO entrance edges are true; stairs are false. No accessibility or current access certification.
nodes.digitization: Manual inspection of dated vector-outline PDF; two-pixel-per-PDF-point inspection coordinates converted using x=(pixelX-710)/3.6, y=(1364-pixelY)/3.6. Approximate, not surveyed.
uncertainties: Auditorium 170 refers to sheet 1, which is not supplied. Lower auditorium doorway and western descending access are retained as separate destinations; no speculative route through seating/stage is added.
